title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Position Details



Title: Administrative Assistant

Start Date: ASAP

Location: Fully remote



Who are Hannan Tew?



We are a boutique, NewLaw Australian immigration law firm focusing on delivering client-centric immigration solutions. We work across all areas, of Australian immigration, and represent clients from asylum seekers to global organisations. The firm is staffed by passionate immigration professionals (including an Accredited Specialist in Immigration Law) with extensive experience in global law firms and a drive to "beat yesterday". We love innovation and thrive on adapting to change. Over the last 8 years we've focused on constantly improving and evolving our systems to ensure our clients have access to the best in market immigration service. We're a small team (10 lawyers + 6 admin staff) but have been steadily growing off the back of a commitment to immigration excellence and love for technology. 



Opportunity



We’re looking for a highly motivated, fantastic communicator to assist with the administrative aspects of our firm. You will report to our Practice Manager, who is based at our head office in Melbourne. We are offering an initial 6-month contract with the potential to transition into a full-time position, and we are seeking a candidate who is genuinely interested in long-term opportunities with our team.



What you can expect to work on



- assist with the drafting of basic forms using templates (including visa application forms)

- ensuring electronic files are updated via our internal systems to track matters / assist with document collection from our clients

- drafting
s, letters, forms and cost agreements using templates

- assist with phone /
 enquiries as required

- other adhoc duties as required



What we’re looking for



- bachelor qualifications or higher is looked at favourably

- experience within a professional services environment is preferred

- excellent written / verbal communication skills – we value plain English law which means clear and prompt communication from start to finish

- highly detail-oriented with excellent time management and organisational abilities

- an ability to work independently and manage competing deadlines

- strong organisational skills and attention to detail

- a knowledge of basic legal software and an ability to adapt to our technology stack (CRM, databases, file management)

- strict compliance with cybersecurity controls

- an ability to mesh with a supportive and highly driven team culture

- a strong sense of ethics and interest in the immigration space

- access to stable, high speed internet



We also value these attributes



- an eagerness and motivation to learn and better themselves

- an interest in innovation and legal tech

- previous experience in client facing roles, and/or high-volume transactional environments



What do we offer you?



- a great work culture in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

- opportunity for real growth and to build your own “niche” within our firm as we look to grow our practice (and develop your talent along the way)

- a salary of AUD $1,200 per month (converted to PHP at spot rate)

- home office set up including laptop, monitor and other essential equipment



Due to a high volume of applications, we are only able to consider candidates who provide the following within their application: 

- a very brief introduction on why you are interested in the role; and

- an up-to-date resume (when providing links, please ensure that these are viewable).

title: Devops Engineer
description:
ESTIMATED HOURS: On-call retainer / as-needed - NOT fixed hours, 5 hr/week (spikes during i
)



PAYMENT STRUCTURE (IMPORTANT -READ CAREFULLY):

- 50% paid in ETH (Ethereum), bi-weekly

- 50% paid in GMI token, vesting linearly over 18 months

- This is an aligned, skin-in-the-game structure

- If you want pure cash only, this role is NOT for you

- If you believe in Web3 and want long-term upside, keep reading



RESPONSE SLA: You must acknowledge any request or alert within 24 hours. Every time. This is the #1 requirement.





ABOUT US

Our team at Energi Core runs production blockchain infrastructure on AWS -EKS (Kubernetes), RDS databases, EC2 instances, RPC nodes, and indexers, across both mainnet and testnet environments. Our senior DevOps is excellent but overloaded. We need a blockchain-native engineer on standby to handle routine operations, catch problems early, and keep everything healthy.



We are past our build phase. We are not hiring someone to architect or refactor. We are hiring someone to WATCH, MAINTAIN, and FLAG.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Monitor RPC node health: sync status, peer count, block lag, reorg frequency

- Monitor indexer health: subgraph lag, indexing errors, data drift

- Watch RDS database pressure: CPU, connections, storage

- Monitor EKS pods, nodes, and load balancers across mainnet and testnet

- Triage alerts with blockchain-aware judgment (mainnet first)

- Run weekly cleanup: unattached EBS volumes, orphaned IPs, old snapshots, stale container images, old CloudWatch logs

- Enforce tagging, access control, and documentation standards

- Produce weekly and monthly infrastructure health reports

- Handle user onboarding and offboarding across GitLab, VPN, and AWS SSO

- Escalate production-critical or architectural issues to Senior DevOps with chain-aware context





WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No mainnet deploys, rollbacks, or architecture changes

- No validator key or signer operations

- No VPC, networking, or security group changes

- No IAM policy design

- No database migrations or schema changes

- No Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code changes

- No mainnet i
 response (you escalate immediately)

- Nothing that touches wallets, trading paths, or revenue systems



HARD REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

We have learned the hard way that generic DevOps does not work for blockchain. If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply:



1. Minimum 2 years of hands-on production blockchain infrastructure experience at a crypto or Web3 company (not a hobby, not a bootcamp, not a side project)



2. Proven experience operating full nodes or RPC nodes in production -Geth, Erigon, Nethermind, Reth, or equivalent



3. Proven experience running indexers or subgraphs in production -The Graph, Subsquid, Ponder, or custom-built



4. Hands-on Kubernetes / EKS experience running stateful chain workloads



5. Strong AWS fluency -EC2, EBS, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, Cost Explorer (console AND CLI)



6. kubectl fluency -get pods, describe, logs, top, delete, exec



7. Dashboard literacy -CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus



8. Discipline to respond within 24 hours, every single time, without fail



9. Genuine comfort being paid 50% ETH and 50% GMI vested over 18 months





NICE TO HAVE (BONUS)

- Experience with EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, etc.)

- Validator operations or staking infrastructure exposure

- MEV infrastructure or block-building familiarity

- Helm, Karpenter, or Terraform (read-only is fine)

- Prior on-call rotations on blockchain infrastructure

title: URGENT: 1 Experienced "AI UGC" VEO/CapCut Editor - ( NOT for beginners! )
description:
Please read the ENTIRE description before applying! :)



A few words about us:



Hey! We are Organic Media, a micro-agency creating and distributing educational and engaging AI-generated short-form videos for e-commerce brands, mainly in the pet niche.



You’ll work directly with our amazing manager ( 20 years old from Europe, with over 3 years of real experience in this exact space ), who has personally prepared A FEW HOURS step-by-step tutorials on Loom to teach you everything from the ground up.

No confusion. No guessing. No wasted time. ( Most tea
mbers learned the workflow within a few days and are now working fully independently )



IMPORTANT: We're also currently building a custom tool for our work environment that will outsource 80% of your tasks meaning you'll be able to produce more videos. This will be a game-changer ( this summer )







What kind of videos will you create?

Simple UGC-like short-form videos fully based on the provided scripts by us. Some of them are silently advertising products at the end but the key is that it doesn't sound like an ad but rather a native short-form video which a real person/influencer would record with their iPhone. There are a few styles such as just a calm "sit down" video ( where there's only one image and the influencer would just talk for 2 minutes ) or other ones where there're a few "shots" of them with a few seconds each and the scenes change but it's really not difficult at all - just a few more generations and then connecting them in CapCut.





The process is straightforward:

Getting our scripts ready and approved, using your own creativity and generating high quality base images using tools like Nano Banana Pro, turning these images into video clips using platforms like Veo3, voice cloning it, dead air cuts and trimming, other minor adjustments such as background audio effects if needed ( like supermarket background audio ). Whole process is 90% just creating the right images/video clips etc. Everything is shown clearly in the training.



You’ll be creating a lot of videos a day but these are not complex edits AT ALL. Difficulty level: 6/10 ( again, 80% is just generating the rate "input" images and later just animating them with voice. That's it )





Here are visual examples of what the videos look like ( NOT OURS ):

1. 
/reel/DZ3OINxk4YP/

2. 
/reel/DZf2JKum4A4/

3. 
/reel/DZm-Ep1Pvwg/

Training & onboarding ( this is the biggest advantage )

Once hired, you will receive structured video tutorials. In total, we have a few hours available, though most people don’t need all of it. The workflow is clear so no missing steps and no “figure it out yourself.”







Daily workload ( important )

You’ll create around 10 to 20+ videos per day ( 1 to 2 min long - we’ll start with a smaller amount and later increase it - won't negatively affect your monthly pay. We just want to make it easier for you to start - ultimately we'll be doing 20+ but making sure it's under 8-10h a day, at first it may take you longer and we may work harder - but once learned it easily becomes manageable ).

In reality, you'd have exactly 4 unique "AI influencers" but all of 4 them have the same scripts to use, you'd just need to change a few words to help with the context ( some of them might be talking only about "dogs" but some about "cats" so just need to change a few words to make it all make sense ) and you could use the same image prompts to generate almost identical images for each influencer. In reality it’s just 2 to 6 original videos PER INFLUENCER ( 4 of them ) and each with a very similar structure. Once trained, this is very manageable.



Your job is simple:

Create the videos, export them, and send them to us daily on our Google Drive.

That’s it. No posting. No account management. No stress.







Equipment & storage ( we make this easy )

You’ll need a good computer that can smoothly handle 1080p/light 4k video editing ( we’ll do 1080p but we’re going to work on multiple browser tabs ), a stable internet connection, and at least 16GB of RAM and 250GB+ of fast storage AVAILABLE. 1TB+ of SSD storage is preferred ( make sure it’s SSD and not old and slow HDD ).







Tools & software ( HUGE upside )

You get FREE access to Veo3 ULTRA costing $200+ and many more in near future!,

We provide logins, instructions, and full support.





Work environment & communication

You’ll have a private 1:1 chat with our manager and separate one to send your daily work in, work fully remotely through 
, receive clear feedback, and be treated as a long-term tea
mber, not disposable labor.

No stressful interviews. No micromanagement. No slow
s back and forth.







Responsibilities

- Adjust our scripts for the context

- Create videos from start to finish.

- Export and send them on Google Drive.

- Apply feedback and improve.

- Prepare scripts for the next day.

- Organize files properly.

- Communicate clearly.

- Hit deadlines without reminders.

That’s it. Simple, repetitive, and enjoyable.







This job is perfect for you if

You’re looking for long-term stability ( months or years ), you’re willing to learn, tech-savvy, creative, organized, and able to focus consistently. You already have video creation/editing experience. Already done some AI influencers related jobs and have good experience in: Google VEO3, Nano Banana Pro, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut PRO and other similar tools. Your computer can handle multiple tabs open ( A LOT of them ). You care about doing things properly, understand and speak English well, respond to messages quickly, and can work up to 6 days per week. You’re a young, talented, smart individual. You’re okay with a slightly heavier learning phase in the first week, you’re not afraid to ask questions, you’re reliable and honest about mistakes.

We value dedication, reliability, and improvement more than raw talent.







This job is not for you if

You’re looking for quick money, disappear without communication, can’t focus, you’re on the older side and have never edited 1 video in your life, never played with the AI tools mentioned above, your computer can’t handle having multiple tabs open at the same time, have unstable internet, refuse feedback, rush work carelessly, avoid consistency, or cannot communicate in English.







Salary & payments

title: Assistant Video Editor – (Part-Time, Adobe Premiere, Flexible Scheudling)
description:
I am a video producer/editor starting a small media production company based in Kentucky, USA. I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Assistant Video Editor to join my team part-time. We want someone who has mastered the technical fundamentals of editing (file management, syncing multi-cam, culling, and pacing) and is eager to be trained and shaped into our specific creative style. We love beautiful cinematic visuals and great storytelling!



This position starts part-time (10–15 hours per week) with the goal of growing your hours, responsibilities, and pay as you master our style and our production volume scales.



We work on wedding films, real estate videos, as well as marketing content, so this is an a great opportunity to grow your skills while working on a variety of projects.



Key Responsibilities (What You'll Do):



Media Management & Ingest: Download raw footage, organize project panels, create proxies, and mirror our standardized folder structures.



The Assembly Cut: Cull through raw footage, sync multi-cam angles and external audio, and cut out dead air to build a tight, engaging rough story assembly.



Rough Polishing: Place baseline B-roll according to project briefs, apply color correction, and execute rough audio leveling.



Photo Editing: Light touch ups for real estate projects and creating thumbnail images from video.



Workflow Tracking: Keep your progress updated in real-time on our ClickUp dashboard.



Note: You build the foundation. I will typically handle the final creative styling, advanced color grading, and final audio mastering. As you adapt to our style guidelines you will be able to take on more responsibilities.



Requirements (Who You Are):



Technical Fluency: Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro with current access to the most up to date version. You must thoroughly understand project organization, keyboard shortcuts, and proxy workflows.



Coachability: You have a clean, solid portfolio, but you have no ego. You welcome constructive feedback and enjoy tweaking your work to match a specific brand's style. We take pride in the quality of our work.



System-Oriented: You are highly organized, pay strict attention to small technical details, and are comfortable tracking tasks inside ClickUp.



Hardware Setup: A reliable editing computer, a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps), and a power backup solution.



Compensation & Hours:



Hours: 10–15 hours per week to start (Flexible scheduling)



Rate: $5.00 USD per hour.



Growth: Performance-based increases in both hours and hourly rate as you take on more advanced editing tasks



How to Apply:

- A link to your portfolio or and resume of recent work.

- A brief 1-2 sentence statement on why you are interested in this opportunity.

- Your current internet speed test screenshot.



ATTENTION: To show you have throughly read this job description, please include the word “Apple”in your application subject line (Example: Apple - Assistant Video Editor Application). If you do not include this word, your application will be automatically filtered out.

title: Performance Video Editor for Mobile App Ads | UGC + Faceless Creative
description:
Gratitude Plus is a consumer mobile app and the leading Social Gratitude Journaling App, with more than 1 million users across 170 countries and a 4.9-star App Store rating.



We are looking for a performance-focused video editor to create short-form ads for Meta and TikTok.



You will work directly with our founders to turn raw creator footage, scripts, app recordings, and visual concepts into ads that capture attention, hold interest, and drive app installs.



This role is best suited for an editor who understands that an effective paid ad is not always the most polished video. It is the video that communicates an idea clearly, connects with the intended audience, and produces results.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Edit short-form paid social ads, typically 15 to 60 seconds long

* Turn scripts and raw UGC footage into clear, engaging ads

* Create variations by testing different hooks, captions, calls to action, pacing, and visual treatments

* Develop faceless and graphics-led concepts using app footage, text, motion graphics, notifications, stock footage, and other visual assets

* Bring rough creative ideas or reference ads to life, even when there is no traditional creator footage

* Review feedback and advertising results, then apply those learnings to future edits

* Suggest improvements to hooks, structure, and visual execution

* Use AI tools to improve the speed and quality of editing, asset creation, and ideation



OUR CREATIVE APPROACH



We have tested hundreds of ads and developed repeatable formats that work for our product and audience.



You will receive scripts, creative briefs, raw footage, reference ads, brand assets, and feedback from previous tests. Some assignments will be clearly mapped out. Others will begin as rough ideas that require you to determine the best visual execution.



We are looking for someone who can follow a detailed brief while also thinking independently.



Strong performance editors understand pacing, storytelling, retention, and viewer behavior. They can identify where an ad is losing 
ntum and make practical editing decisions that improve the final result.



TYPES OF CONTENT YOU WILL EDIT



* UGC creator ads

* Founder-led ads

* Customer stories and testimonials

* App demonstrations and screen recordings

* Faceless storytelling ads

* Motion graphics and text-led ads

* Lock screen notification concepts

* Variations of existing winning ads



Most projects will combine UGC, app footage, captions, graphics, and supporting visual assets.



Advanced motion design is helpful but not required. You should be comfortable creating clean motion graphics and turning a faceless concept into a complete ad.



EXPECTED WORKLOAD



This is a long-term, full-time independent contractor engagement.



You can expect approximately:



* 25 concepts or content batches per month

* About five batches per week

* Four to five variations per concept

* Around 100 completed video variations per month



The variations within each batch are usually small adjustments rather than entirely separate edits. For example, one concept may use four different opening hooks while keeping the remainder of the video the same.



Each batch should generally be completed within a few days of receiving the footage, assets, and creative brief.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* Experience editing short-form social content

* A portfolio that includes UGC, paid social, direct-response, or faceless ads

* Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, captions, and retention

* Experience creating graphics-led or faceless videos

* Proficiency with modern AI tools and the ability to use them in your workflow

* Ability to manage consistent weekly output while maintaining quality

* Comfort receiving direct feedback and completing revisions

* Strong communication, organization, and reliability

* Ability to meet recurring deadlines without close supervision



Experience with consumer mobile apps, Meta ads, TikTok ads, or motion graphics is a plus.



COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUSES



Monthly compensation is $800 to $1,100 USD, depending on experience, editing ability, and overall fit.



Compensation will be paid at the end of each month.



You will also receive a $50 performance bonus for every individual video that reaches a predefined advertising spend threshold.



The spend threshold and bonus tracking process will be explained before the ongoing engagement begins.



PAID TRIAL



We will begin with a paid trial consisting of three content batches.



Each batch will include one advertising concept with approximately four to five variations, for around 15 total videos.



Trial compensation is $50 per batch, for a total of $150 USD.



All three batches should be completed within one week. You can expect one to two rounds of feedback and revisions as we become familiar with each other’s working styles.



Following a successful trial, the engagement will transition into consistent monthly work.



SCHEDULE AND WORKING HOURS



You may complete the work during normal Philippine working hours.



You are not required to work US hours or remain online during the US workday. Communication, briefs, and feedback will primarily be asynchronous.



You will be responsible for managing your own working schedule, communicating consistently, and meeting agreed-upon deadlines.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction explaining your editing experience

2. A link to your portfolio

3. Two or three examples of paid social, UGC, or faceless ads you edited

4. A list of the editing and AI tools you regularly use

5. Your expected monthly compensation within the listed range



Start your application with the words “Gratitude Editor” so we know you read the complete listing.

title: Product UX Designer - Trial Activation
description:
Start your application with MANGO.



We need a part-time product / UX designer for Carby, a carb-conscious meal planning app. This is not a generic visual polish role. The priority is fixing the first-session value problem after trial checkout.



Business context:

- Only 28 of 99 matured trials became paying customers. 45 canceled and 22 went past due.

- About 84% of trial users reach the app, but only 40-50% cook within 24 hours.

- Signing in alone is not success. The user needs to get obvious value quickly enough that they want to stay.

- Our next target is 40% trial-to-paid conversion, with 50% as the excellent target.



Your main focus:

- Walk the full journey: checkout -> app sign-in -> first meal plan -> grocery list -> choosing/cooking dinner -> returning the next day.

- For every user video or flow review, identify one exact break: what the user expected, what the screen needed to prove, what happened, why they might cancel or not return, and one concrete fix.

- Prioritize usefulness, confusion, trust, billing clarity, payment problems, app access, first meal-plan value, grocery-list value, and next-day return.

- Spend most of your attention on first-session value after checkout, not later screens or generic UI polish.



Good designers for this role:

- Can watch user videos and turn confusion into one specific product change.

- Think in activation and retention, not just fonts, spacing, colors, or taste.

- Can write clear before/after UX copy and simple wireframes for the exact screen causing the break.

- Can explain why a fix should increase trial-to-paid conversion.

- Are comfortable reviewing checkout, onboarding, app sign-in, meal-plan creation, grocery-list creation, and return-use flows.



Bad fit:

- Mostly comments on visual polish without tying it to cancellation or retention.

- Suggests broad redesigns instead of one concrete change to the broken 
nt.

- Stops at sign-in instead of checking whether the user gets meal/grocery value.

- Does not understand how billing/trust confusion can cause cancellations.



To apply:

- Start with MANGO.

- Send 1-2 examples of product/UX work where you improved activation, onboarding, checkout, retention, or conversion.

- Describe one specific app flow you improved: what was confusing, what you changed, and what metric or user behavior improved.

- Tell us your hourly rate, weekly availability, and whether you can work with Loom/user videos and Figma.

- Include one short idea for Carby: if a trial user reaches the app but does not cook within 24 hours, what exact screen or 
nt would you inspect first, and why?

title: Event Sales & Client Relations Specialist (Remote)
description:
About Deloro Valley

     At Deloro Valley, we create unforgettable, premium weddings and events. We pride ourselves on delivering a seamless, stress-free planning experience for our clients. Because we host major, once-in-a-lifetime events, our team must be both warm and welcoming to prospective couples, and exceptionally meticulous when planning their big day.



Role Overview

     We are seeking a full-time, remote Event Sales & Client Relations Specialist. This is a dynamic, balanced role that is 50% consultative sales and 50% detailed event operations. You will take the lead on warm inquiries (no cold calling) from our marketing channels and referrals, walk them through their options via video calls, and close the sale to secure the booking.

     Once the client is excited to move forward, you will transition into execution mode—drafting highly detailed contracts, managing their accommodation preferences, and building comprehensive Run-of-Show documents. You will work closely with the clients until handing the flawless plan over to our on-site day-of execution team.

     Note on Compensation: Because we value high attention to detail and organization just as much as sales, this role offers a premium, fixed salary rather than a commission structure, rewarding excellence in both closing deals and managing meticulous and extensive logistics and contracts.



???? Shift & Schedule

     Standard Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM PST (includes a 1-hour break). Note: This corresponds to 1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT (Philippine Time).

     Weekend Flexibility: While this is primarily a Monday-to-Friday role, occasional weekend availability (a few hours) is required. This is strictly on an as-needed basis—specifically if a high-value client is only available to meet on a weekend, or in the rare event of an urgent, time-sensitive emergency. We highly value work-life balance and keep these instances to a minimum.



Compensation & Benefits

-Salary: $1,200 – $1,500 USD / month (Flat premium base salary, paid bi-weekly. Exact starting rate depends on your track record in sales and event operations).

-Paid time off (after a probationary period).

-A stable, premium, and supportive work culture.



Key Responsibilities

1. Inbound Sales & Closing (The Sales Hat)

-Lead Management: Respond quickly to warm inquiries and referrals.

-Video Consultations: Conduct professional, warm Zoom video consultations to understand the client's vision, present our packages, and build trust.

-Closing Contracts: Confidently guide prospects through the decision-making process, handle objections gracefully, and close the sale to secure the venue booking.

-Highly Detailed Contracting: Draft, review, and issue complex, highly detailed booking contracts. You must ensure all custom additions, addendums, and specific pricing terms are 100?curate before finalizing.



2. Event Coordination & Logistics (The Operations Hat)

-Client Onboarding: Welcome newly booked clients and walk them through the venue planning process.

-Accommodation Management (RezNexus): Accurately map out and input guest room assignments within RezNexus, ensuring lodging arrangements perfectly match the booking party's specific requests and desires.

-Ticket and Lodging Sales Management:  For clients that wish to pass some of the costs of their event onto their guests, setup their interface according to clients desired prices and details.

-Run-of-Show Building: Collaborate directly with clients to map out their exact timeline, floorplans, vendor lists, and event details.

-Systems Management: Keep our key software (Tripleseat, RezNexus, and GoHighLevel) meticulously updated with highly detailed client communication, contracts, timelines, and lodging details.

-On-Site Team Handoff: Package all finalized documents into a seamless, error-free handoff bundle for our physical, on-site event team to execute flawlessly.



Requirements & Qualifications

-Proven Sales & Closing Experience: You have a track record of consultative selling, handling objections, and closing contracts (experience in events, hospitality, high-ticket coaching, or real estate is a massive plus).

-Flawless English Communication: Exceptional spoken and written English is non-negotiable. You must be highly confident, articulate, and professional on video calls with high-paying US clients.

-Extreme Attention to Detail: You will be handling contracts with many minor details and complex event timelines. One missed detail can ruin a wedding, so you must love spreadsheets, organization, and double-checking your work.

-Flexible Mindset: You understand the nature of the events industry and are willing to log on for a few hours on a weekend occasionally to accommodate a client meeting or handle an urgent situation.

-Tech Adaptability: Experience with Tripleseat, RezNexus, or GoHighLevel (GHL) is a huge plus, but not required. You must, however, be highly tech-savvy and able to master new platforms quickly.

-Dedicated Home Office: High-speed internet (with a backup plan), a modern computer, a high-quality webcam, and a quiet, professional background for client video calls.



How to Apply:  To apply, please submit:

-Your resume/CV.

-A short (1-2 minute) Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your sales or client relations background.

(Applications submitted without a video introduction will not be considered).

description:

Who we are



We’re Concept Accounting & Advisory, a Canadian CPA firm specializing in real estate businesses — brokerages, teams, and property investors across Canada. We’re small, growing fast, and building a modern, tech-driven firm without the corporate layers. We run on QuickBooks Online, Dext, TaxDome, and Microsoft 365.



We’re building our offshore team right now, and we’re hiring the people who grow with us as we scale. If you want to be an early, key member of a team (not employee #97), this is that.



Why join us



- Competitive USD salary, paid twice monthly, reliably and always on time.

- 13th-month bonus, paid mid-year (July), based on performance.

- Annual performance bonus on top of your salary review.

- Two weeks paid vacation, increasing with your tenure.

- Paid December Holiday shutdown.

- Medical coverage after your first year in good standing.

- A real, visible growth path. As we grow our team, you’re first in line to move into a senior/lead role; reviewing others’ work and helping build our offshore function. We hire with that path in mind.

- Direct work with the firm principal (ex-Deloitte) and manager (ex-Canada revenue Agency), your ideas land, no bureaucracy.

- Fully remote, work from your home office.



What you’ll do



- Month-end bookkeeping and close (accrual and cash basis) for multiple clients in QuickBooks Online

- Provide in-depth analysis of client files, identify inaccuracies and inconsistencies, notify clients, and resolve issues independently.

- In-depth review of their clients' month-ends and financial statements (Balance sheet, P&L, aged payables, aged receivables)

- Ensuring clients’ books are kept up-to-date and are accurate and organized, meeting deliverable deadlines.

- Answering more complex bookkeeping-related support questions from clients through Taxdome

- Bank and credit-card reconciliations across client files

- Document and receipt processing in Dext

- Managing multiple clients of varying complexities simultaneously in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment

- Post clear file notes and communicate daily with your manager on Microsoft Teams and Taxdome

- Spot process-improvement and automation opportunities as you learn our systems

- Assist with knowledge sharing and support the company’s growth by preparing and reviewing periodic SOPs, and helping maintain the firm SOP Library in Notion.



What we’re looking for



- 8+ years hands-on accounting, including at least 2–3 years inside a US or Canadian accounting firm, you know the month-end cadence, review culture, and client-file discipline of a North American practice.

- CPA (PRC) a strong plus, tell us your license status.

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience as your daily tool (close and reconciliations); Xero a plus

- Clear written and spoken English, you’ll document work and communicate daily

We read every application that follows these steps. Ones that skip them, we don’t:

2. Attach your resume (PDF).

3. State your years inside a US/Canadian accounting firm, and your PRC CPA license status if you hold one (a strong plus, not required).

4. In 3–4 sentences, describe one QuickBooks Online cleanup or month-end close you personally completed, and what was messy about it.

6. Confirm you can work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (this is a night shift in the Philippines).

title: REO Portal Virtual Assistant Equator Pyramid RESNET Cascade
description:
We are a high volume real estate brokerage specializing in foreclosure, REO, and institutional listings. Our team works directly with asset managers, lenders, and government entities and operates in fast paced, compliance driven environment. Accuracy, consistency, and follow through are critical in this role. This is a long term opportunity for the right virtual assistant who wants stability, growth, and real responsibility in the REO space.



We are seeking an organized, detail driven Virtual Assistant to handle foreclosure and REO tasking across multiple client portals. Accuracy is crucial in this role. This position supports properties from assignment through closing and requires strong follow through, deadline management, and the ability to work independently within structured systems. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in portals, following task checklists, and maintaining compliance without constant oversight.



Primary responsibilities include completing all required tasks in REO and foreclosure portals, maintaining daily updates and status changes, monitoring deadlines and escalation requirements, and accurately uploading documents, photos, bids, and reports. You will be responsible for maintaining compliance across all client instructions and identifying missing or incorrect items before they become issues. Strong comprehension is needed in this position.



This role also includes coordinating with field staff and vendors, ordering inspections, occupancy checks, preservation services, and repair bids, and following up as needed. Inspections and bids must be reviewed for completeness and obvious discrepancies before submission. You will assist with BPO tasking and organization, including managing photos, comparable data, and required documentation.



Additional responsibilities include coordinating utility turn ons and shut offs, requesting HOA payoff statements and resale disclosures, assisting with title related items such as deeds, tax information, and lien data, supporting MLS data entry and updates when needed, and maintaining accurate internal records and tracking.



Prior experience with REO, foreclosure, or bank owned properties is required. Applicants should be prepared to list which portals they have worked in, how long they have handled REO or foreclosure files, and the types of tasks they managed on a daily basis.



Strong attention to detail, excellent written communication, and the ability to work independently are essential. This role requires someone who is organized, reliable, and comfortable with repetitive, accuracy driven work. Candidates must be able to troubleshoot issues as they arise and communicate clearly when escalation is needed.



Technical requirements include reliable high speed internet, a quiet home work environment, and proficiency with Google Workspace. Comfort using PDFs, spreadsheets, cloud storage, and task driven systems is required.



This is a full time position during Arizona, United States business hours. We offer a stable long term role with clear systems, structured training on our workflows and clients, and opportunities to grow into higher level REO coordination and oversight positions.



To apply, please include a brief summary of your REO or foreclosure experience, a list of portals you have worked in such as Equator, Pyramid, RESNET, Bid on Homes, or similar systems, and your availability to work United States business hours. Qualified candidates will be provided with a link to officially apply in our database.

Managing multiple tenders and quotations at the same time

Responding to tight tender and customer deadlines

Obtaining and following up supplier best-buy and project pricing

Checking product availability, freight charges and lead times

Preparing variation and alternative pricing

Keeping clear records of quotation versions and revisions

Updating CRM records promptly and accurately

Communicating quickly with customers, suppliers and internal staff



The successful applicant must be organised, responsive and able to work efficiently under pressure without compromising accuracy.



Skills and Experience Required



The successful applicant should have:



Commercial flooring estimating, quantity surveying or construction estimating experience

Strong experience reading and interpreting architectural plans and specifications

Proven digital take-off and pricing skills

Experience using MeasureSquare M8, CAD-based take-off software or similar estimating programs

Experience using MeasureSquare CRM or another modern CRM platform

A good understanding of sales pipelines, quotation follow-ups and customer records

A good understanding of flooring materials, installation methods and floor preparation

The ability to build complete material, labour and subcontractor pricing

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

Excellent computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly

Confidence using Microsoft Office, Google Workspace and AI tools

Strong written and spoken English

Confidence communicating with customers online

The ability to manage multiple tenders, revisions and deadlines

A proactive attitude and the ability to work well as part of a team

Preferred Software Experience



Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:



MeasureSquare M8

MeasureSquare CRM

AutoCAD

Bluebeam

PlanSwift

CostX

Cubit

RFMS Measure

STACK

Other CRM or digital take-off software

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

A suitable computer capable of running MeasureSquare M8 and handling large plan files

A backup internet connection

Backup power or access to a reliable alternative workspace

A quiet and professional work environment

A headset and camera for online meetings and client communication

What We Are Looking For



We need someone who can do more than measure plans.



The right person must be able to understand the complete flooring scope, quantify accurately, source competitive pricing, manage revisions, identify risks, and present a complete professional quotation to the customer.



They must also be comfortable managing enquiries and quotations through a CRM, scheduling follow-ups, maintaining accurate records, and helping progress opportunities from initial enquiry through to acceptance.

Application Requirements

Your current city and province

Your computer specifications and internet connection details

Examples of previous estimating or take-off work

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability to start

40 hours per week



Pay



NZ$14–$21 per hour, depending on experience

You will act as a central operator, managing high-volume communication channels, resolving urgent guest issues, and utilizing software platforms to audit property readiness while maintaining an empathetic, welcoming tone.



Key Responsibilities

-Guest Communications & Operator Management

Channel Operations: Handle all inbound guest communication across Property Management Systems (Cloudbeds, Guesty), major Online Travel Agencies and booking channels (Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, 
, and the like), and dedicated guest services phone lines.

-Rapid Resolution: Promptly address, troubleshoot, and resolve urgent guest issues, including maintenance emergencies, technical property failures, or access control concerns.

-Empathetic Connection: Establish a warm, personal connection with guests at booking to anticipate needs, manage expectations, and deliver a 5-star experience from booking through review.

-Escalation & Problem Solving: Use all available tools, software, and resources to resolve local issues independently; efficiently escalate critical operational threats to internal leadership.

-Client Adaptability: Tailor communication styles fluidly to accommodate a wide variety of clients, property owners, and travelers.

Operations & Tech Auditing

Cleanliness Verification: Coordinate directly with housekeeping and maintenance teams to verify that cleanings and property turnarounds are completed within tight timeframes.

Daily Readiness Audits: Conduct daily digital audits of property management tasks to ensure all boutique units and vacation rentals are fully prepared for arriving guests.

Smart Home Audits: Perform routine technical audits of property systems, including thermostat settings, smart locks, and automated guest access codes.

Security & Quality Monitoring: Review property camera footage and hardware logs as permitted to verify real-time property readiness and security conditions.

Task Assignment: Log, track, and assign outstanding property issues to field teams, ensuring no maintenance request goes unresolved.

Qualifications & Ideal Candidate Profile

Required Qualifications

Experience: 2–3+ years of experience in hospitality, guest services, customer support, vacation rentals, boutique hotels, or a related field.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a warm, professional, hospitality-first approach under pressure.

Adaptability: Proven ability to handle the fast pace of a central hotel operator, managing multiple software channels and client personalities simultaneously.

Technical Proficiency: Highly comfortable with property management software (Cloudbeds, Guesty), Online Travel Agencies and booking platforms (Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, 
, and the like), CRM tools (GoHighLevel, Market MySTR, Slack, Google Workspace, and smart home applications).

Problem Solving: Calm, resourceful, and swift in critical or fast-moving situations.

Work Environment: Experience working remotely and independently while maintaining absolute accountability and rapid response times.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting boutique hotels, vacation rentals, or concierge-style hospitality services.

Direct experience coordinating with remote housekeeping, maintenance, and dispatch teams.

Deep knowledge of channel managers, reservation systems, PMS platforms, and automated CRM guest messaging flows.

Who You Are

You genuinely enjoy helping people, resolving friction, and creating memorable experiences.

You are always receptive, coachable, and eager to grow alongside an expanding brand.

You are naturally proactive, highly dependable, and take deep ownership of your daily workflows.

You have an eye for aesthetics, presentation, and the thoughtful details that define a luxury stay.

You thrive in the technical, fast-moving side of hospitality operations and customer service.

Schedule & Availability

Location: 100% Remote.

Time Zone: Must be available to work primarily during Pacific Time (PST/PDT) hours.

Hours: Typical schedule is 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM Pacific Time, including weekends and holidays.

Flexibility: Hospitality is a seven-day-a-week business; flexibility is required to support urgent real-time guest and operational needs.

Requirements: Must have a highly reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet and professional workspace, and the ability to remain continuously responsive throughout scheduled shifts.

Guests consistently receive rapid, thoughtful, and personalized communication.

Property audits, check-in details, and operational tasks are executed flawlessly and without delays.

Maintenance and housekeeping teams stay perfectly synchronized and supported.

Properties are verified to be clean, functional, and fully ready before every guest check-in.

title: Funding Specialist - Business/Personal Funding
description:
Funding Specialist (Funding Success Manager)



**Fourth Quarter Consulting | Part-Time with ability to expand to Full-Time| Remote**



We help business owners get approved for $50K to $150K+ in funding through credit card stacking and personal loans. Our clients are strong borrowers with 700+ credit and clean profiles.



We're looking for a Funding Specialist to own the client experience from the 
nt they sign to the 
nt they're funded and paid. Right now that work lives in the founder's head. Your job is to take it off his plate and run it better than he could.



This is not a call center role and it's not a lead-blasting role. You'll manage a small book of high-value clients and make each one feel like they're the only one you have.



## What you'll own



- Pull and read client credit reports, then build a funding strategy: which cards, in what order, the limits to expect, and the timeline.

- Walk clients through prep so their profile is application-ready. Utilization down, no stray inquiries, business entity set up if it's needed.

- Run the application stack on schedule and log every approval, decline, and limit as it comes in.

- Keep clients calm and informed through the 2 to 4 week funding process with clear updates that go out on time, every time.

- Produce the final funding report, send the invoice, and follow through until the payment actually lands.

- Check in after funding to line up repeat rounds and referrals.

- Keep the CRM clean and current. If it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen.



## What we're looking for (MUST HAVE)



- You've read tri-merge (3-Bureau) credit reports before and you know what a fundable profile looks like. This one is non-negotiable.

- You understand credit card stacking and personal loan funding, or you've worked right next to it and you pick things up fast.

- You're the kind of organized where nothing slips. You can carry 8 to 10 active clients at once without dropping a step.

- Your written and spoken English is clean and professional. Clients trust you inside the first five minutes.

- You actually like working with clients. You follow up before they have to chase you.

- You're independent. Give you a goal and a playbook and you run with it. You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what to do next.



## Nice to have



- Experience in credit repair (CFPB, FTC, DisputeFox) as well as funding.

- Time spent in a CRM like GoHighLevel, Notion, ClickUp

- You've helped build or tighten up SOPs, not just followed them.



## What you get



- A real book of high-value clients, not a spammy cold list.

- Playbooks and templates so you're not guessing. Where they don't exist yet, you'll help build them.

- Direct access to the founder. No layers, no politics. 1-1 directly under the founder.

- Room to grow into running the whole fulfillment side as we scale.



## How we'll measure you

## You'll know exactly what winning looks like. Once you're ramped, here's what we expect:



- Strategy docs out fast. Every funding strategy delivered within 3 business days of a client signing.

- Clients funded on time. Average client goes from signed to funded in 21 to 28 days. Nobody sits stuck in a stage longer than 7 days without you flagging it.

- Follow-through. 85%+ of your clients complete their prep and application steps on schedule, because you're staying on them.

- Money collected. Final report and invoice out within 3 business days of the last approval, and payment confirmed within 7 days of funding.

- Nobody goes dark. Every active client hears from you at least once a week with a real update, not a "just checking in."

- CRM stays current. Statuses and notes updated the same day, every day. No end-of-week catch-up.

- Referrals and reviews. A testimonial and referral ask on every client once they're funded and happy.



## How to apply



Send us:



- Your resume

- 2 to 3 sentences on your credit and funding experience. Be specific about what you've actually done, not what you've read about.

- One example of a time you kept a client on track through a process with a lot of moving parts.



Use the subject line: **"Green Light"**



Applications without that subject line or without real credit experience won't get read. We work in the details here, so show us yours.

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Systems Engineer — Dockerized LTX-2.3 GPU Inference Platform
description:
Dockerized LTX-2.3 Inference Pipeline — No ComfyUI Runtime



I’m looking for an experienced ML infrastructure engineer to build a fully containerized LTX-2.3 inference pipeline.



This is not a traditional frontend-focused full-stack role. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with deep experience in Python, PyTorch, Docker, CUDA, cloud GPU deployment, model serving and production-grade backend systems.



I do not want ComfyUI to be used as the runtime interface. The final system should run directly through Docker and allow inference jobs to be submitted programmatically or through a simple command-line/job specification workflow.



The scope includes:



- Containerizing the complete LTX-2.3 inference environment with Docker.

- Managing model downloads, caching and persistent model storage.

- Supporting configurable inference parameters such as prompt, seed, resolution, duration, frame rate, output path and optional image/video conditioning.

- Accepting jobs through a simple and documented mechanism, such as JSON job files, CLI commands or a lightweight queue.

- Saving generated videos and job metadata to persistent storage.

- Providing clear logs, job status and useful error messages.

- Ensuring the container can run reliably on cloud GPU providers.

- Documenting deployment, configuration and usage.

- Avoiding ComfyUI as a production dependency or runtime interface.



Before implementation, I expect a short architecture proposal covering:



1. The proposed components and data flow.

2. How inference jobs will be submitted and processed.

3. Docker image structure and dependency management.

4. Model storage and caching strategy.

5. GPU and VRAM management.

6. Error handling, retries and job recovery.

7. Output storage and metadata.

8. How the system could later scale to multiple GPU workers.

9. Security and isolation considerations.

10. Estimated implementation stages and deliverables.



The first version should prioritize simplicity, reliability and reproducibility. I am not looking for an unnecessarily complex Kubernetes or microservices setup unless there is a clear technical reason for it.



Application instructions



Do not send a generic or templated proposal.



To be considered, your response must include:



- A brief description of a similar GPU inference or ML deployment you have built.

- Your recommended job-submission mechanism for this project and why.

- A high-level architecture for the solution.

- The main technical risk you expect when containerizing LTX-2.3.

- How you would handle model weights so they are not downloaded on every container start.

- The cloud GPU provider or deployment environment you would recommend.

- A realistic breakdown of the implementation into milestones.



Begin your proposal with the sentence:



“The main operational risk in this project is…”



Proposals that only repeat the job description, contain generic claims or do not answer the technical questions above will not be considered.



Expected deliverables



- Dockerfile and supporting configuration.

- Reproducible build and deployment instructions.

- Job submission script or CLI.

- Inference worker implementation.

- Example job configurations.

Narration-driven long-form videos

Automatic editing

Final video exported without a human editor

title: AI Video Automation App - Vibe Coder - AI Engineer
description:
I'm building an internal web platform that turns a script into a finished YouTube video automatically.

I want to upload a script, select a saved AI character (avatar) and voice, and click Create. The system then automatically via API:



Generates the voiceover

Generates AI avatar footage of the character speaking the script

Pulls matching stock b-roll for each scene, made with AI (Videos and Images)

Assembles the complete edited video (avatar intro, b-roll body, split-screen segments) — no human editor



These channels are the output format and quality we're building toward. Watch a few videos before applying:















Dashboard steps & capabilities:

Script upload ? automatic scene breakdown with timestamps and b-roll keywords (LLM API)

Character library — save avatars per channel + create new ones (AI image ? animated talking avatar)

Voice library — saved voices per character

Auto-pull b-roll from Pexels/Pixabay APIs matched to each scene

Auto-generate avatar footage speaking the script (typically the opening minutes + transitions, not the full runtime)

Auto-assemble the final video following editing rules (avatar open ? b-roll ? split-screen ? avatar close)

Render queue, project history, per-video cost tracking



Requirements:



Total generation cost must land around $1-5 per video (20–30 min videos). Expensive convenience APIs like HeyGen can't be the default — use low-cost or open-source approaches (open-source lip-sync on rented GPUs, budget TTS, free stock APIs, FFmpeg assembly), or propose your own way to hit the number. Will still have access to Heygen and other tools

Every layer must be swappable — voice, avatar, b-roll, and rendering providers can be switched later without rebuilding. Option to select program wanted. Choose between VO tool or Avatar tool. The APIs stay stored in the dashboard.

Fully automated end-to-end — script in, video out. A simple review screen to swap clips before final render is a plus.



Relevant skills: FFmpeg / programmatic video assembly, AI media pipelines (ComfyUI, Replicate, fal.ai, RunPod), TTS and image/video generation APIs, full-stack web development.



To apply, start your application with the word READ and answer:



How would you build this, layer by layer, with the specific tools you'd use and cost per video?

Show me anything you've built involving AI video, avatars, or automated media.

Timeline to a working v1?



Final step before hiring is a small paid test: I give you a short script, you produce a 2-minute sample video.

title: Operations and Accountability Lead
description:
If keeping people moving toward a goal is just "how you're wired", and watching 
ntum die HURTS you to your core - read on.



You're the person who can't leave a loop open.



When something was supposed to happen and didn't, you FEEL it.



Not because you need control - because incomplete action is genuinely uncomfortable to you.



You follow through - not because someone asked you to, but because it comes naturally to you.



You don't need to be the loudest person in the room. You don't need credit. You need COMPLETION.



The Work



Your job, put simply, is this -

Make sure the right things are happening at the right time.



Right now that means one defined project with a clear finish line. 



We're building a system from zero - setting it up, getting it running, and making sure it's documented and tested before it goes live. 



That's Phase One. 



Your job is to make sure it crosses the finish line completely and correctly.



After that, the work shifts to three ongoing modes:



First, you'll own the recurring pulse - ensuring pipeline, commitments, and follow-through are done on time and completely. Making sure nothing goes cold without a deliberate decision to let it go cold.



Then you'll help prioritize and delegate what comes up - the one-off tasks, the gaps that need closing along the way.



And you'll keep the system honest - making sure the people responsible for keeping it moving are actually keeping it moving.



You're not DOING the work. 



You're MAKING SURE the work GETS DONE.



You won't be on an island.



The answers, the context, the access - it's all there when you need it.



You only have to ask for it, use it to help build the systems we need, and make sure everyone is doing their part to keep that system moving.



The Offer



This is a small team with a proven offering.



It's made up of people that genuinely want to be held accountable.



That's not something you'll find everywhere.



You'll have real access, real permission, and a team that's actively asking for what you naturally do.



If you're the person we're describing, this isn't just "a job". It's the right fit for you.



Details



This starts as a defined project. If you execute it well, it becomes an ongoing role.



This is a full time position starting at $4/hour.



Some familiarity with CRM systems or marketing automation is helpful. If you have the character and a general familiarity with the skills, we'll train you on everything else.



Tools, systems, process - all of that can be learned.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED.



When the core project is complete, we'll find work that fits you. You won't be left idle.



To Apply



When you apply, tell us about a time something was ABOUT TO fall through the cracks and YOU were the reason it didn't.



In Closing



If you need to be managed, this isn't the right fit.



If you're the one who usually ends up doing the managing - even when it's not your job - and you'd love a role where that's exactly what's needed - let's talk.



'Cuz honestly, WE need to be managed.

 marketing, influencers and retail channels.

mbers to keep projects on schedule.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
Social Media Assistant

Part-Time — Christian Author Book Marketing Campaign

Location: Remote (Philippines-based candidates preferred)

Hours: 25 hours/week

Duration: 3-month contract, with possibility of extension based on campaign results

Compensation: To be discussed based on experience — please include your rate expectations in your application

About the Role

We're launching a 3-month book marketing and publicity campaign for a Christian author and are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Social Media Assistant to build and manage the author's presence across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves faith-based content, understands social media platforms deeply, and wants consistent part-time work supporting a meaningful project.

You won't be responsible for creating the core content — video reels, graphics, and written copy will be provided to you. Your role is to bring that content to life on the platforms: scheduling, posting, light editing, and growing genuine engagement.

What You'll Do

• Set up and optimize the author's profiles/pages on
, Instagram, and LinkedIn (bio, branding consistency, pinned content, links)

• Schedule and publish content at least 3–4 times per week across platforms, using content provided (text, video reels, photos, graphics)

• Perform light editing on video reels when necessary (trimming, captions, resizing for platform specs)

• Occasionally assist with light content creation (repurposing existing material into platform-specific formats, simple graphics, caption writing)

• Monitor comments and messages daily, responding warmly and promptly, or flagging items that need the author's/team's personal attention

• Actively grow engagement — following relevant accounts, engaging authentically in comments, using appropriate hashtags, and applying platform best practices to build reach

• Track basic performance metrics (likes, shares, comments, follower growth) and provide a simple weekly or bi-weekly summary

• Communicate proactively with the campaign lead about scheduling, content gaps, or ideas

What We're Looking For

• Excellent written English — clear, warm, and error-free, since you'll be posting and replying on behalf of the author

• Proven experience managing and growing social media pages, ideally for an author, ministry, coach, or personal brand

• Comfortable using scheduling tools (e.g., Buffer, Meta Business Suite, Later) — experience with Buffer specifically is a plus

• Basic video editing skills (CapCut, InShot, Premiere Rush, or similar) for trimming and formatting reels

• Understanding of what drives engagement on
, Instagram, and LinkedIn respectively — you know these are not “one post fits all three” platforms

• Reliable internet access and the ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision

• Genuine comfort with and respect for Christian/faith-based content and audiences

• Strong communication and time management — this role requires consistency, not just skill

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting an author, speaker, or ministry-related brand specifically

• Basic graphic design skills (Canva)

• Familiarity with Instagram/Facebook Reels trends and short-form video best practices

How to Apply

Please send:

1. A brief note about your experience with social media management (especially any author, ministry, or personal brand accounts)

2. Links to any pages/accounts you've managed or grown, if available

3. Your availability and preferred working hours

4. Your hourly rate expectations

description:

Our company is a Los Angeles–based design and build company with over 9 years of experience serving homeowners across Southern California. We specialize in ADU construction, home remodeling, additions, and full design-build projects — and we’re growing fast!

Proven experience creating Meta

title: Dental Sales & Lead Conversion (Remote)
description:
Compensation: Base salary (PHP) + commission per booked and attended consultation + performance bonuses

Start Date: ASAP



We run a high-end dental practices in Brisbane, Australia specialising in dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, porcelain veneers, and complex cosmetic dentistry. We generate consistent inbound leads through
 and Instagram advertising, and we need a sharp, confident communicator to convert those leads into booked consultations.



This is a sales and coordination role, not a clinical one. You won't be doing dentistry. You will be the first human voice a potential patient hears and your job is to make that count.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

Responding to inbound leads within minutes of them coming through via SMS, phone call, and messaging platforms. Qualifying leads using a structured conversation framework to understand treatment interest, timeline, and financial readiness. Educating prospects on treatment options at a high level using provided scripts and materials. Overcoming objections, building rapport, and guiding patients toward booking a consultation. Following up consistently with warm leads who haven't yet committed. Logging all activity and lead status accurately in our CRM (GoHighLevel). Coordinating with our in-clinic team to ensure smooth handovers for booked patients.



What We're Looking For

You either have a background in dentistry, dental reception, or healthcare coordination or you're someone who learns fast and takes the time to genuinely understand what we offer before picking up the phone.



You have a clear, neutral, or near-Australian/American accent. This is non-negotiable. Our patients are Australian and the communication needs to feel natural and credible from the first word.



You're a confident communicator who doesn't shy away from discussing money. Our treatments range from $5,000 to $60,000+. You need to be comfortable having that conversation calmly and without hesitation.



You're hungry. The commission structure rewards results, and if you're good at this, your earning potential here is significant.



You're organised and self-directed. We're not managing you minute-to-minute. You'll be given a system, scripts, and leads - your job is to execute.



Required

Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear neutral, Australian-adjacent, or American accent. 

Proven experience in a sales, customer service, or patient coordination role. 

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional environment for calls. 

Comfort using CRM software (GoHighLevel experience is a bonus, not a requirement). 

Availability during Australian business hours (and after-hours / weekends)



Preferred

Experience in dental reception, treatment coordination, or medical/healthcare administration. Familiarity with dental terminology - implants, veneers, All-on-X, etc. Prior remote sales experience with a performance-based compensation structure.



Compensation Structure

Competitive base salary (commensurate with experience). Commission paid per consultation that books and attends. Additional bonuses tied to monthly performance targets. Exact figures discussed at interview stage — the structure is designed to reward people who perform.



How to Apply

Record a short 60-90 second video introducing yourself, explaining your relevant experience, and demonstrating your spoken English. Include this with your application along with your CV. 



Applications without a voice or video sample will not be reviewed.

title: SEO Delivery Specialist (Part-Time, 20-30 hrs/week) - Australian SEO Agency + Directory Portfolio
description:
About the role



I run two connected businesses from the Gold Coast, Australia:  an SEO and Google Ads agency servicing Australian clients, and a growing portfolio of Australian directory websites (legal, real estate, trades and professional services niches).



Right now, SEO delivery runs through me. That is the problem this role fixes. I set the strategy and build the task list. You action it, reliably, every week, without me chasing.



This is a fulfilment role. You will be judged on tasks completed and quality of execution, not meetings attended. If you like clear briefs, ticking things off and seeing rankings move, this will suit you. If you need constant direction or prefer strategy over execution, it will not.



One thing about how I work: this is an AI-first operation. I use Claude daily across the businesses and I expect you to do the same. When you hit a question or get stuck, your first move should be working it out with AI, not messaging me. If you can solve 90% of your own blockers, you'll do very well here. Your SEO judgment still has to be your own though. AI speeds up good work, it does not replace knowing what good work is.



What you'll be doing





On-page SEO implementation: meta titles and descriptions, headings, internal linking, content updates

Publishing and formatting content in WordPress (Elementor and Gutenberg)

Technical SEO fixes: redirects, schema, indexation issues, site speed basics

Monitoring in Google Search Console and Ahrefs, flagging issues and wins

Drafting monthly reporting for clients and portfolio sites

Working through a prioritised task board in Notion and keeping it updated

Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to speed up workflows where it makes sense

Documenting what you do into simple SOPs as you go





Must-haves





2+ years hands-on SEO execution experience (agency experience preferred)

Strong on-page SEO skills and current knowledge of best practice

Confident in WordPress, including Elementor

Experience with at least one major SEO tool suite (Ahrefs, SEMrush or similar)

Comfortable using Google Search Console day to day

Reliable, self-managing and honest about progress. If something is stuck, you say so early

Good written English. Most communication is async via Notion and

Available 20-30 hours per week within Australian business hours (AEST)





Nice-to-haves





Experience with directory or programmatic SEO sites

GEO/AEO knowledge (optimising for AI search visibility)

Basic HTML/CSS

Real experience using Claude, ChatGPT or similar in actual workflows, not just chat. This one is heavily weighted, tell me about it in your application

Reporting tool experience (AgencyAnalytics, Looker Studio or similar)





Rate and setup





USD $5-9 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly or fortnightly

Part-time to start (20-30 hrs/week) with a path to full-time as workload grows

Long-term role. I want someone who stays, learns the businesses and grows with them

Fully remote, direct hire, no agency in between





Growth path



Nothing here is systemised yet. The right person will help build the SOPs for how delivery runs, and as the portfolio and client base grow, there is a real path to leading the delivery function with support underneath you. That is not a promise of a title in month one. It is what happens if you prove execution first.



How to apply



Reply with:





Your updated resume or profile

Your answer to this question: Describe one website you personally improved. What exactly did you change, and what happened to its traffic or rankings as a result? Be specific.

Your answer to this question: Describe one real way you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT etc) in your work. What was the task, how did you use the tool, and where did you have to correct or override it?

Your available hours per week and preferred rate

The word "phoenix" at the top of your reply so I know you read this far





Applications without specific answers to questions 2 and 3 will not get a response.



Shortlisted candidates will be offered a paid trial task (a real on-page audit and implementation on one of my sites, paid at your rate) before any ongoing commitment.
